agent.problem: The marked correct answer broadens Numbers 36:6. Saying the daughters may marry "anyone they please within their father's tribe" omits the requirement that they marry within a clan of that tribe, making it sound as though any man from any clan in the tribe qualifies.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

rule.text: Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.
